dogecoin.text: The Solana-based token #BONK rises 12% as a result of the recent increase in the dog-related cryptocurrency market. Amidst reports of cryptocurrency inclusion, #Dogecoin, #Floki Inu, #Shiba Inu, and Bonk saw notable increases.
Dogecoin ( $DOGE) jumps 34%, reaching a $42 billion market cap and overtaking #USDC.
